cards.example_zh: 我真的很佩服我的祖母。

cards.example_en: Runners advance toward the finish when the whistle blows.
cards.example_zh: 哨声一响，赛跑的人就向终点前进。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：航空公司
cards.example_en: Which airline are we taking for the family holiday?
cards.example_zh: 这次全家出去度假，我们坐哪家航空公司？

cards.example_en: The airplane landed late because of thick fog.
cards.example_zh: 因为浓雾，飞机晚点降落了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：字母表
cards.example_en: The alphabet song helped my little brother learn letters.
cards.example_zh: 字母歌帮我弟弟学会了字母。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：任何地方
cards.example_en: I can't find my keys anywhere.
cards.example_zh: 我在任何地方都找不到钥匙。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：扶手椅
cards.example_en: Grandpa fell asleep in the armchair after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后，爷爷在扶手椅上睡着了。

cards.example_en: My cousin joined the army after finishing high school.
cards.example_zh: 我表哥高中毕业以后参军了。

cards.example_en: Perfect attendance earned him a prize during assembly.
cards.example_zh: 他因为全勤，在集会上得了一个奖。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：自动的
cards.example_en: The automatic doors opened as we entered the supermarket.
cards.example_zh: 我们走进超市时，自动门打开了。

cards.example_en: Our baggage was too heavy for the airport trolley.
cards.example_zh: 我们的行李太重，机场的手推车都不好推。

cards.example_en: A wooden barrel stood beside the farm gate.
cards.example_zh: 农场大门旁立着一只木桶。

cards.example_en: The flight was late because of the weather.
cards.example_zh: 由于天气原因，航班晚点了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：存在；生物
cards.example_en: A human being needs water every day.
cards.example_zh: 人这种生物每天都需要水。
